subject: general
question: ______ leaves are used to make bidis.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tendu**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Tendu leaves are primarily used to make bidis, which are a traditional type of hand-rolled cigarette in India.
 
• The leaves are known for their strength and elasticity, making them ideal for rolling bidis.
 
• Tendu, also known as Diospyros melanoxylon, is a tree found widely in central India.
 
• The collection and sale of tendu leaves are a significant source of income for forest-dwelling communities in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Bidis**

 
 
• Bidis are traditional Indian cigarettes made by rolling dried tobacco flakes in a tendu leaf and securing the roll with a thread.
 
• They are often cheaper and smaller than regular cigarettes, making them accessible to a larger population.
 
• Despite their small size, bidis deliver a higher amount of nicotine, tar, and carbon monoxide compared to conventional cigarettes.
 
• The bidi industry is labor-intensive, providing employment to millions of people, especially women and children in rural areas.
 
 
 
• **Tendu (Diospyros melanoxylon)**
 
 
• Tendu is a species of flowering tree in the family Ebenaceae, native to India and Sri Lanka.
 
• The tree produces small, sweet fruits that are edible, but its leaves are more commercially valuable.
 
• Tendu leaves are collected during the summer months and are dried and processed for use in bidi production.
 
• The economic importance of tendu leaves has led to government regulation and control over their collection and trade in various states of India.
